title: Sam Dutrey as an improviser
summary: The elder Sam Dutrey was a great improviser who held his lip like Lorenzo Tio.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you August, did you ever know anything about these clarinet players such as Sam Dutre?
Yeah, Sam Dutre used to play with the good. I'm telling you about it. I was playing with Helen Edwards.
Oh yeah, you heard him play? Yeah. How was it?

The old man. I'm not talking about his son. I'm talking about the old man. Yeah. Sam, now you're talking about a good improviser. Oh yeah. Oh, he was a great improviser. Great improviser. And Reed too. I never heard him play. He was a good improviser. One of the good of his improvisers as anyone was around him. Sam Dutre.
Did he play the same way you're saying about Lorenzo with the lip?
Yeah. He played the same way. Sam played just like her.
